rules.description: Opening metadata uses the required standard keys in their defined order.
Opening metadata keys must not be duplicated.
Every document-set file ends with the required identity trailer.
The Sources catalog identifies the authoritative inputs for a document set.
INDEX routes readers to the selected operation and required context.
Markdown headings and backtick-fenced blocks retain deterministic source-line boundaries.
Pipe tables use source-level boundary pipes, escape parity, separators, and consistent column counts.
Docs-root-relative paths and INDEX profile links use their exact ASCII source grammars.
Required one-line prose uses the literal source-level sentence-terminator grammar.
